senses.gloss: ch. same, to be great, esp. to be a teacher, be in office.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:7:5">Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᵇ</cite> top <he>כגון אנן דרַבְבִינָן משגחין וכ׳</he> such as we, who are teachers: people look up to us to answer their questions; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:7:5">ib.</cite> <he>ואנן אפי׳ רבבינן וכ׳</he> and we, although we are teachers, we know not &c.
